subject: RE: outreach bot
body: Spec: personalised cold emails to 200 leads (name, company). Fill {first name} and {company}. Max 50 a day, working unsubscribe link, never email an unsubscriber, no duplicates. And a Test button that sends the first 3 to me.

hints: Offer to build the cold-email bot.
